title: 636017 Move Sales report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Sales report action tooltips are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, eliminating duplicates across role centers and pages where these reports are invoked.
key_points: Tooltip definitions moved from 5 sales reports' action invocations to the report objects
Action tooltips removed from 9 pages and role centers across W1 and 18 country layers
Tooltips now apply wherever reports are invoked via the 2025 release wave 1 UI descriptors feature
Completes the sales area migration, leaving no remaining sales reports with duplicate tooltips
Metadata-only change with no functional impact on report behavior
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for 5 Sales reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
